extra_run_args.description: Passes your Wayland socket in so VS Code can open a window. The tmpfs gives VS Code a writable XDG_RUNTIME_DIR for its IPC socket; only the single compositor socket is shared, not the rest of /run/user
GPU access for hardware-accelerated rendering; without it Electron falls back to software rendering or fails to start
Disables SELinux confinement for this container only. The Wayland socket is labelled user_tmp_t on the host, which a confined container cannot reach, so VS Code would fail to connect to your display
Chromium uses shared memory for cross-process IPC and crashes once the 64MB default is exhausted

Tightens the container beyond the default: drops every Linux capability except the four the entrypoint needs to remap the penguin user to your UID/GID and drop privileges, and blocks privilege escalation. This strengthens isolation rather than weakening it
Caps runaway extensions or language servers at 4GB of RAM and 512 processes so they cannot exhaust your machine
